# High-speed configuration descriptor of a UAC2 sink with three streaming
# alternate settings of the format 24/3, one per synchronization type of
# the data endpoint (bmAttributes D3..2, USB 2.0 Table 9-13): 1
# asynchronous with its explicit feedback endpoint (05), 2 adaptive (09),
# which also declares a feedback endpoint, 3 synchronous (0d) without one.
# The adaptive and synchronous endpoints' class-specific descriptors carry
# bLockDelayUnits 2 (decoded PCM samples) and wLockDelay 1 (UAC2 Table
# 4-34). One descriptor per line, in hex, wTotalLength bytes in all.
09 02 e9 00 02 01 00 80 32
08 0b 00 02 01 00 20 00
09 04 00 00 00 01 01 20 00
09 24 01 00 02 08 2e 00 00
08 24 0a 04 03 07 00 00
11 24 02 01 01 01 00 04 02 03 00 00 00 00 00 00 00
0c 24 03 03 01 03 00 01 04 00 00 00
09 04 01 00 00 01 02 20 00
09 04 01 01 02 01 02 20 00
10 24 01 01 00 01 01 00 00 00 02 03 00 00 00 00
06 24 02 01 03 18
07 05 01 05 46 02 01
08 25 01 00 00 00 00 00
07 05 81 11 04 00 04
09 04 01 02 02 01 02 20 00
10 24 01 01 00 01 01 00 00 00 02 03 00 00 00 00
06 24 02 01 03 18
07 05 01 09 46 02 01
08 25 01 00 00 02 01 00
07 05 81 11 04 00 04
09 04 01 03 01 01 02 20 00
10 24 01 01 00 01 01 00 00 00 02 03 00 00 00 00
06 24 02 01 03 18
07 05 01 0d 46 02 01
08 25 01 00 00 02 01 00
